summary: Remote-controlled PTY shell driven by a configurable WebSocket server
details: The package connects out to a WebSocket server (default ws://localhost:3456, overridable via SERVER_URL / configuration) and routes incoming messages to handlers that spawn a system PTY (bash / pwsh / cmd) via node-pty and write remote-supplied bytes directly into the shell (handleTerminalCreate: pty.spawn(terminalInvocation.command,...); handleTerminalInput: term.pty.write(msg.data) driven by socket.on('message') -> handleMessage case 'terminal_input'). Whoever controls the configured WebSocket endpoint therefore has full interactive shell access on the host running the agent. A separate message type 'upgrade_agent' causes the agent to run `npm install @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest` and restart via systemd / launchd / PM2, letting the same remote server force arbitrary future package versions onto the host. service/linux.js also mutates the installer's PATH (~/.local/bin, ~/.npm-global/bin) at install time to support the agent's own binaries.
